children: Karamtara Engineering Limited are a backward-integrated manufacturer of products for the renewable energy and transmission line sectors. They are the largest integrated manufacturer in India in terms of installed capacity for solar mounting structures and tracker components in Fiscal 2026. Their aggregate installed capacity was 889,200 MTPA (including 492,000 MTPA for solar products, equivalent to approximately 16.81 GW) and 480,000 pieces as of March 31, 2026 (excluding their galvanizing capacity). They offer a diverse product portfolio, enabling them to serve as a one-stop shop for solar structures, including fixed-tilt and tracker systems. They offer structures and fasteners for the solar energy and transmission sectors, as well as overhead transmission line (“OHTL”) hardware fittings and accessories. They were one of the largest exporters of solar products from India to North America in Fiscal 2025, according to the F&S Report. They have also forayed into the wind energy sector, commencing production of angular towers for wind turbines and tubular towers for wind turbines in March 2025 and June 2025, respectively. Further, they intend to enter the battery energy storage systems (“BESS”) business through their wholly owned subsidiary, Karamtara Green Energy Limited (“KGEL”), which was incorporated in May 2025. In addition, they intend to set up manufacturing facilities for prefabricated engineered building (“PEB”) structures.

At the upper price band, the company is valued at 35.7x FY26 P/E and 18,3x FY26 EV/EBITDA, implying a post-issue market capitalization of ₹81,743 million. The company can be viewed as a vertically integrated renewable-energy and transmission equipment manufacturer, with its key strengths being large solar capacity, backward integration, a broad product portfolio and an established export base.
